gate_logic.class_collapse_definition: Any target class with 0 predicted instances or np.nan F1

selection_criterion: Maximizing mean Delta F1 and minimizing class collapses strictly on T1-T3 development set. T4/T5 were never inspected during gate selection.

metrics.primary: Mean Delta F1 Macro (Frozen Gate vs Control)
secondary: Mean Delta F1 Macro (Frozen Gate vs PCR-Always)

production_decision_criteria: Mean Frozen Gate ΔF1 vs Control > 0
Mean Frozen Gate ΔF1 vs Control > 0 independently on BOTH T4 and T5

The primary ticker-clustered paired-bootstrap 95% CI for Frozen Gate vs Control must not cross zero for a PRODUCTION_CANDIDATE verdict. (If >0 point estimate but crosses zero -> PROMISING_BUT_INCONCLUSIVE)
Severe Regression Concentration: <5% of all validation observations and max 1 severe regression per ticker cluster

notes.t1_status: The T1 cold-start rule is part of the development/pre-registration exercise and is not included in the independent T4/T5 validation population.
notes.provenance_check: T4 and T5 were never inspected during gate selection. No T4/T5 metric influenced the thresholds. The gate was frozen before this validation.

constraints: Validation results cannot alter the gate. T4 outcomes must not be incorporated into T5 historical state (static boundary).
